name: scholarflow
description: ScholarFlow AI - AI-powered Scholarship Workflow Automation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db npx prisma generate && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
